title: Normalized completion comparison for any ordinary tensor presentation
statement: Fix the finite-field datum D, prime l different from its characteristic, finite coefficient extension E, and a scheme X over D.k with quasicompact separated structure morphism, as in def-sf-rational-verdier-data; no finite-type assumption is required. Let a be any ordinary normalized integral tensor-Hom presentation. Then the Completion(D,l,hl,X,E,a) structure is inhabited: it has a natural comparison to completed tensor, invertible on constructible pairs, whose good K-flat representative is exactly the fixed completionChain of def-sf-rational-verdier-data.

proof.text: Unpack the normalized constructible tensor-completion theorem with the same chosen chain map as completionChain. Restrict a.representative to the good-complex subcategory.

The good-complex functor is a localization. Full faithfulness of restriction to its product descends the ratio of the two ordinary tensor comparisons to an isomorphism from a.tensor to the ordinary tensor supplied by completion.

Compose that isomorphism with the supplied completion map. Its components on constructible pairs are invertible. The fully faithful preimage equation and associativity prove the exact prescribed representative equation.
